descriptions.w3d_d31e_read_object_file_80202714: Reads an object file into a table of objects: runs the header reader (tracing and returning on failure) and the section readers, allocates the object table at +28, creates the objects of each class record at +124 through the factory from 0x8020b648 and each class's maker, stores the root object in the result with a reference, lets each object read itself and reports it to the optional listener at +36, frees the table, and runs the sort pass with state 2. Returns 0, or E_FAIL when a class has no maker. Names are inferred.
